name: fuzz-api
description: Fuzz-test an API against its schema for robustness/security bugs.
body: Fuzz the API in $ARGUMENTS using the `api-fuzzing` skill (schemathesis/RESTler). Generate malformed and edge-case inputs from the schema, exercise stateful/auth sequences, and report crashes, 5xx, and contract violations with reproductions.

name: flaky-report
description: Find and triage flaky tests, propose root-cause fixes.
body: Analyze $ARGUMENTS using the `flaky-test-management` skill. Identify intermittently-failing tests, classify the cause (order dependence, shared state, time/network nondeterminism), and propose real fixes over blanket retries. Report a ranked list. Read-only analysis.

name: a11y-audit
description: Run an automated + manual accessibility audit of a page.
body: Audit $ARGUMENTS using the `accessibility-testing` skill. Run axe for automated checks, then reason through keyboard navigation, focus order, and screen-reader semantics that automation misses. Report WCAG issues by severity with fixes.

name: perf-test
description: Design and run a load/perf test with regression thresholds.
body: Build a performance test for $ARGUMENTS using the `performance-testing` skill (k6). Model a realistic load profile, assert p95/p99 thresholds (not averages), and report a pass/fail suitable as a CI gate.

name: saga-design
description: Design a distributed transaction as a saga with compensations.
body: Design a saga for $ARGUMENTS using the `saga-orchestration` skill. Choose orchestration vs choreography, define each step's compensating action, and ensure every step is idempotent and the saga state survives crashes. Output the step/compensation map.

name: outbox-check
description: Check event publishing for the transactional-outbox pattern.
body: Review $ARGUMENTS using the `transactional-outbox` skill. Detect dual-write bugs (DB write + broker publish not atomic), confirm an outbox table + relay + consumer dedup exist, and flag unbounded outbox growth. Report fixes. Read-only.

name: resilience-audit
description: Audit service integrations for timeouts, retries and breakers.
body: Audit the integrations in $ARGUMENTS using the `resilience-patterns` skill. Check every outbound call has a timeout, retries use backoff+jitter, circuit breakers/bulkheads protect shared resources, and fallbacks exist. Report gaps by risk. Read-only.

name: tenancy-check
description: Check multi-tenant isolation and per-tenant limits.
body: Review $ARGUMENTS using the `multi-tenancy` skill. Look for cross-tenant data leakage (missing tenant scoping on queries), noisy-neighbor risks, and missing per-tenant quotas/rate limits. Report severity-ranked findings. Read-only.

name: microfe-plan
description: Plan a micro-frontend split with shared-dependency strategy.
body: Plan a micro-frontend architecture for $ARGUMENTS using the `micro-frontends`/`module-federation` skills. Define boundaries, shared singleton deps and versions, runtime composition, and failure fallbacks. Flag where a monolith is the better call.

name: statechart
description: Model a complex UI flow as an explicit state machine.
body: Model $ARGUMENTS as a statechart using the `state-machines` skill (XState). Enumerate states, transitions, guards and side effects, eliminate impossible states, and output the machine definition plus a diagram description.

name: llm-guardrail
description: Add input/output guardrails to an LLM feature.
body: Review the LLM feature in $ARGUMENTS using the `llm-guardrails` skill. Ensure output is schema-validated, PII is redacted from prompts/outputs, and content policy is enforced outside the model. Report what to add. Read-only.

name: rag-eval
description: Evaluate a RAG pipeline's retrieval and answer quality.
body: Evaluate the RAG pipeline in $ARGUMENTS using the `rag-evaluation` skill. Measure retrieval recall/precision, groundedness/faithfulness, and answer quality against a golden set. Report metrics and the weakest stage (chunking/embedding/retrieval/generation).

name: prompt-injection-scan
description: Scan an agentic/RAG system for prompt-injection exposure.
body: Scan $ARGUMENTS using the `prompt-injection-defense` skill. Find places where fetched/tool content is treated as instructions, trusted and untrusted context are mixed, or tools run without authorization. Report exposures and mitigations. Read-only.

name: structured-output
description: Make an LLM call return validated structured output.
body: Review $ARGUMENTS using the `structured-output` skill. Replace free-text parsing with JSON-schema/tool-calling, add validation + repair on invalid output, and handle streaming partials. Report the changes. Read-only.

name: devcontainer
description: Scaffold a reproducible devcontainer for this project.
body: Scaffold a devcontainer for $ARGUMENTS using the `devcontainers` skill. Detect the real stack, add devcontainer.json with the right features, keep the image lean with caching/prebuilds, and keep secrets out of the image. Report how to open it.

name: conv-commits
description: Set up Conventional Commits with linting and changelog.
body: Set up Conventional Commits in $ARGUMENTS using the `conventional-commits` skill. Add commitlint + a commit-msg hook and wire automated changelog/version bumping. Report the config and how enforcement works.

name: renovate-setup
description: Configure safe automated dependency updates.
body: Configure automated dependency updates for $ARGUMENTS using the `renovate-dependencies` skill. Group related updates, schedule sensibly, gate merges on tests, and automerge only safe (patch/minor, security) bumps. Report the config.

name: workflow-design
description: Design a durable long-running workflow.
body: Design a durable workflow for $ARGUMENTS using the `durable-execution`/`workflow-engines` skills. Separate deterministic workflow code from side-effecting activities, add retries/timers and compensation, and keep state recoverable. Output the workflow/activity breakdown.

name: semantic-layer
description: Define a governed metrics/semantic layer.
body: Design or review a semantic layer for $ARGUMENTS using the `semantic-layer` skill. Centralize metric definitions, assign ownership/governance, and prevent divergent metrics across BI tools. Report the model and gaps. Read-only.

name: backpressure-check
description: Check a pipeline for backpressure and load shedding.
body: Review $ARGUMENTS using the `backpressure-flow-control` skill. Find unbounded queues, missing load shedding under overload, and retry storms that amplify failure. Recommend bounded queues, timeouts and shedding. Read-only.
